e.title: GEMAct
e.summary: 非寿险/再保险精算 Python 包（Ann. Actuar. Sci.）：频率-严重度-共因相依建模
e.body: GEMAct（v1.3.0，Gem Analytics）是非寿险（再）保险精算 Python 包：集体风险模型——频率/严重度分布、共因（copula）相依、再保险结构（XL/比例）定价与模拟；方法论论文发表于 Annals of Actuarial Science。对 RIAA：再保险定价与风险聚合的现代开源工具——频率-严重度建模（同 [[insurance-distributional-glm]] 的分布视角）、聚合损失（同 [[aggregate-python]] 谱系）、cat 风险（同 [[oasislmf]]）；配合 [[chainladder-python]]（准备金）形成非寿险全流程工具链。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：PyPI v1.3.0 + 官方文档 + Ann. Actuar. Sci. 论文确认，未实测
e.summary_en: Non-life (re)insurance actuarial Python package (Ann. Actuar. Sci.): frequency-severity with copula dependence modelling
e.summary_hk: 非壽險/再保險精算 Python 包（Ann. Actuar. Sci.）：頻率-嚴重度-共因相依建模
e.body_en: GEMAct (v1.3.0, Gem Analytics) is a Python package for non-life (re)insurance actuarial work: the collective risk model — frequency/severity distributions, copula dependence, reinsurance structures (XL/proportional) pricing and simulation; its methodology paper was published in Annals of Actuarial Science. For RIAA: a modern open-source tool for reinsurance pricing and risk aggregation — frequency-severity modelling (the distribution view shared with [[insurance-distributional-glm]]), aggregate losses (the [[aggregate-python]] lineage), and cat risk (alongside [[oasislmf]]); with [[chainladder-python]] (reserving) it completes the non-life toolchain.
e.body_hk: GEMAct（v1.3.0，Gem Analytics）是非壽險（再）保險精算 Python 包：集體風險模型——頻率/嚴重度分佈、共因（copula）相依、再保險結構（XL/比例）定價與模擬；方法論論文發表於 Annals of Actuarial Science。對 RIAA：再保險定價與風險聚合的現代開源工具——頻率-嚴重度建模（同 [[insurance-distributional-glm]] 的分佈視角）、聚合損失（同 [[aggregate-python]] 譜系）、cat 風險（同 [[oasislmf]]）；配合 [[chainladder-python]]（準備金）形成非壽險全流程工具鏈。
